verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs claim users can 'automate compliance workflows with custom triggers and actions' and monitor controls, evidence, and personnel. Monitoring tests and automated evidence collection via integrations suggest continuous background operation. The support rests only on one-line marketing claims, with no detail on how users configure the automations, scheduling, or autonomous execution, so it reads as compliance-scoped automation rather than general background automations. Missing for 10: documented setup of trigger/action workflows, details on scheduling or autonomous background execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
